verdict.rationale: HMRC runs a live, versioned REST API platform (Making Tax Digital), so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions an MCP server or any first-party AI-agent connection endpoint. References to 'agents' mean human tax agents signing up clients, not AI agents, and the REST API is at most a developer building block, which earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
